units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: <*> The procedure for considering materials on conferral of the honorary title ‘Honorary Citizen of the City of Moscow’ is determined by a law of the City of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “<*> The procedure for considering materials on conferral of the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Regulations on commissions considering petitions for the Certificate of Honour and the Honorary Diploma of the Moscow City Duma are approved by the Moscow City Duma; those concerning the Certificate of Honour of the Government of Moscow are approved by the Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Regulations on commissions considering petitions for the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 1. General provisions
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “1. General provisions”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 1. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Commission) is established by the Mayor of Moscow to ensure an objective approach to considering incentives for citizens and to conduct a public assessment of materials concerning the award to citizens of the distinctions ‘For Services to Moscow’ and ‘For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow’ (hereinafter, distinctions), the honorary badges ‘Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow’, ‘Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow’ and ‘Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow’, the granting of Prizes of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, prizes), and the conferral of professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, honorary titles).
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “1. The Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: For preliminary consideration of petitions for distinctions and honorary titles in the various professional fields, public councils may be established by decision of the relevant heads within municipal administration complexes and sectoral and functional executive authorities of the City of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “For preliminary consideration of petitions for distinctions and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 2. In view of the particular nature of considering prize nomination materials, expert councils are established at the relevant sectoral and functional executive authorities to conduct a public assessment of works and candidates nominated for prizes.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “2. In view of the particular nature of considering prize…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Regulations on expert councils and their membership are approved by Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Regulations on expert councils and their membership are…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: In individual cases, the Mayor of Moscow may establish commissions to consider the award of prizes.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “In individual cases, the Mayor of Moscow may establish…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 3. The Commission is a standing advisory body attached to the Mayor of Moscow and exercises its powers on a voluntary basis. Its decisions are advisory.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “3. The Commission is a standing advisory body attached to the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 4. The Commission’s individual membership is approved by the Mayor of Moscow and comprises First Deputy Mayors and Deputy Mayors of Moscow in the Government of Moscow, ministers of the Government of Moscow, representatives of public organisations and the most authoritative specialists.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “4. The Commission’s individual membership is approved by the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Representatives of the city’s organisations, scientists and specialists may be engaged as experts in the Commission’s work.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Representatives of the city’s organisations, scientists and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 5. In its activities, the Commission is guided by the Charter of the City of Moscow, Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 ‘On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow’, this Decree and other normative legal acts concerning awards and honorary titles.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “5. In its activities, the Commission is guided by the Charter…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Commissions established by the Mayor of Moscow to consider the award of prizes conduct their activities by reference to these Regulations.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Commissions established by the Mayor of Moscow to consider the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 2. Principal functions of the Commission
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “2. Principal functions of the Commission”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 6. The Commission performs the following functions:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “6. The Commission performs the following functions:”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - assesses petitions received for distinctions and honorary titles and considers expert councils’ recommendations for the award of prizes;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- assesses petitions received for distinctions and honorary…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - issues opinions on whether distinctions may be awarded, prizes granted or honorary titles conferred, or on rejecting the petitions and recommendations submitted;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- issues opinions on whether distinctions may be awarded,…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - considers petitions for duplicates of distinctions, breast badges for honorary titles and prizes and their documents; for restoration of rights to distinctions and honorary titles; and for deprivation of distinctions and honorary titles where a nomination for an award (prize or honorary title) is found to be inaccurate or lacking in objectivity;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- considers petitions for duplicates of distinctions, breast…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - considers proposals to establish or abolish awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow and prepares opinions on them;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- considers proposals to establish or abolish awards and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - considers issues concerning the application of legislation on distinctions, prizes and honorary titles, and proposals to improve its application in practice;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- considers issues concerning the application of legislation on…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - issues opinions on draft laws of the City of Moscow and other draft legal acts concerning distinctions, prizes and honorary titles;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- issues opinions on draft laws of the City of Moscow and other…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - considers proposals, applications and complaints relating to distinctions, prizes and honorary titles;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- considers proposals, applications and complaints relating to…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - carries out individual instructions of the Mayor of Moscow concerning awards.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- carries out individual instructions of the Mayor of Moscow…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 3. Rights of the Commission
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “3. Rights of the Commission”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 7. To exercise the powers entrusted to it, the Commission has the right to:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “7. To exercise the powers entrusted to it, the Commission has…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - request and receive from heads of the city’s executive authorities and local self-government bodies, organisations, institutions and public associations, or other officials, the materials and information necessary for its work, including information on criminal convictions and criminal or administrative liability of citizens nominated for awards;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- request and receive from heads of the city’s executive…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - engage representatives of institutions and organisations connected with an issue under consideration at a Commission meeting, as well as employees of outside organisations, specialists and scientists, to prepare opinions on award materials submitted for consideration;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- engage representatives of institutions and organisations…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - refuse to consider and return for revision documents that have been prepared poorly and carelessly;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- refuse to consider and return for revision documents that…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - hear representatives of institutions and organisations at its meetings on the application of the City of Moscow’s award legislation and on specific award petitions submitted to the Commission;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- hear representatives of institutions and organisations at its…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: - inform the Mayor of Moscow on matters within the Commission’s competence.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “- inform the Mayor of Moscow on matters within the Commission’s…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 4. Organisation of the Commission’s work
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “4. Organisation of the Commission’s work”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 8. Commission meetings are held as award petitions are received, but at least once a month.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “8. Commission meetings are held as award petitions are…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Meetings are chaired by the chair of the Commission or, in the chair’s absence, by the deputy chair.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Meetings are chaired by the chair of the Commission or, in the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 9. A Commission meeting has a quorum if more than half of its members are present.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “9. A Commission meeting has a quorum if more than half of its…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Decisions are taken by a majority of the members present through an open vote, in the absence of candidates for awards or honorary titles. In the event of a tied vote, the chair of the Commission (or deputy chair) takes the final decision.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Decisions are taken by a majority of the members present…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: When a petition to grant an award (honorary title) to a Commission member is considered at a meeting, that member is temporarily excluded from the Commission’s work, and this is noted in the minutes.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “When a petition to grant an award (honorary title) to a…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: Representatives of organisations, scientists and specialists invited to a meeting do not participate in voting.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “Representatives of organisations, scientists and specialists…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 10. The Commission’s decision is recorded in minutes signed by the chair (deputy chair) and the secretary of the Commission.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “10. The Commission’s decision is recorded in minutes signed by…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: On the basis of the Commission’s decision, its chair (deputy chair) endorses the draft of the corresponding decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “On the basis of the Commission’s decision, its chair (deputy…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 11. The secretary of the Commission is responsible for its clerical work, the storage and use of its documents, and monitoring timely implementation of its decisions.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “11. The secretary of the Commission is responsible for its…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*>
units.text: 12. Organisational and technical support for the Commission’s work is provided by the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMISSION FOR AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW <*> · “12. Organisational and technical support for the Commission’s…”
